bull.b: Rapid revenue scaling alongside high gross and operating margins indicates that On is expanding without sacrificing profitability. This combination supports reinvestment in innovation, stores and marketing while providing a durable earnings base over the next several quarters.

DTC growth nearly twice as fast as wholesale, combined with full-price discipline, strengthens customer ownership and reduces reliance on retail partners. Higher direct penetration can support richer data, brand control and durable margin quality as the channel expands.

Successful product launches and faster-growing apparel and accessories broaden On beyond a single footwear franchise. A deeper innovation pipeline and expanding category mix can increase customer frequency, raise basket potential and support sustained brand relevance.

bear.b: Persistent promotion can pressure realized pricing and make margin performance harder to sustain, even with current brand discipline. Higher inventory also increases the need for careful assortment and sell-through management, potentially limiting cash efficiency if demand softens.

LightSpray has meaningful demand but remains constrained by production capacity and manufacturing quality management. Until new facilities scale reliably and defects remain controlled, the technology may contribute less revenue than demand suggests and could require continued execution focus.

Asia Pacific is a significant growth engine, but management expects its pace to moderate from the exceptionally strong recent performance. A slower regional contribution could reduce consolidated growth momentum and place more pressure on new categories and other geographies.
